description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per endpoint - the payment buys one signed dialect conformance report: probe mode fetches the named endpoint's live 402 challenge; submitted mode grades your captured artefact set. Per axis it names the challenge carrier, the evidenced client-header names, the payload shape, the amount field name, the network-ID form, and the receipt headers; mismatches are named, undeterminable axes are reported UNDETERMINED, and no composite score is computed. Artefacts are processed in memory only and are never stored.

artefact.description: Submitted mode: one captured challenge/payload set (status?, body_obj?/body_raw?, header_obj?/payment_required_header?, payload_obj?, payload_headers?, response_headers?). Processed in memory only, never stored.

mode.description: The check mode: 'probe' (name one endpoint URL) or 'submitted' (submit one captured artefact set).

url.description: Probe mode: the one endpoint URL whose live 402 challenge is fetched and graded. Never stored.

name: dialect_check
